Their inspected mathematical claims concern step-scaled finite-time accuracy, deterministic periodic time-step resonance, or additive/continuous-time noise; they do not state the universal iid fixed-step second-moment spectral instability together with the explicit Bernoulli transfer and sharp coefficient. value.rationale: A random-time-step symplectic method can individually preserve area at every update yet have unbounded average energy; the precise all-nondegenerate-distributions dichotomy and exact \(O(\varepsilon^2)\) growth coefficient make a natural benchmark for long-time probabilistic geometric integration, and quantify sensitivity close to the deterministic stability boundary. The result is limited to the canonical harmonic oscillator and does not claim a general method-sized advance.
